issue.title: test_mounted_arrival_then_clear_name_keeps_selection loses the selection to message:status in a Master Gate shard, passes on the next SHA and in isolation

task_type_fields.evidence: Master Gate run 38953378752 at docs-only commit 4bd2252f07 (2026-10-16) failed 1 of 7140 in its shard: AssertionError: assert 'u.m@t00' in ('message:status',).
